meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: Claude 会直接向 Gmail、GitHub、Stripe 等外部服务发起 HTTP 请求,由 OneCLI 网关在代理层自动注入已连接的凭证,它本身看不到密钥值;服务未连接时返回一个连接链接。
howto.when: 当你让它读取邮件、查看日历或访问 GitHub 等任何外部服务或 API 时,它会改用网关直连,而不是浏览器扩展或 OAuth 命令行工具。

say.text: 帮我读一下 Gmail 里最新的 5 封邮件
say.note: 网关注入凭证后直接请求 Gmail API

say.text: 列出我 GitHub 账号上前 10 个仓库
say.note: 直接调 api.github.com,不用自己设请求头

say.text: 查一下 Stripe 最近 5 笔付款
say.note: Stripe 未连接时会先返回连接链接

howto.what_en: Claude makes HTTP requests directly to Gmail, GitHub, Stripe and other services; the OneCLI gateway injects stored credentials at request time, so Claude never sees the secrets; unconnected apps return a connect URL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to read email, check calendar, or touch GitHub and any other external service or API; it does not use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools.

say_en.text: Read my 5 most recent Gmail messages
say_en.note: Gateway injects credentials, then calls the Gmail API

say_en.text: List the first 10 repos on my GitHub account
say_en.note: Direct call to api.github.com, no auth header needed

say_en.text: Show the last 5 charges in Stripe
say_en.note: Returns a connect URL if Stripe isn't connected yet
